units.source_text: 昏暗的壁龛柱子附近，可以看见一个大白包似的东西。

en.t: Near the pillar of the dim alcove, something like a large white bundle could be seen.
Looking closely, I realized it was the teacher.

units.source_text: 他竭力曲着身子，把头埋在双膝之间，用双抽捂住了脸，蹲在那里。

en.t: He was crouching there, bending his body with all his strength, burying his head between his knees, and covering his face with both hands.
